shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----RULES; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ----SRC; ls -R src; cat index.html src/*.ts* tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; echo ----VER; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ | head -20

rg -n -C 12 'page-constructor' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,80p; echo ----ICONS; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json
npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -40

npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor @diplodoc/transform 2>&1 | tail -15 && grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs; cat $D/INDEX.md | head -120; echo ----LS; ls $D/blocks $D/guides $D/sub-blocks; echo ----README; rg -n -i -C 3 'required setup|styles\.css|import .*styles|PageConstructorProvider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md | head -80
D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs; echo ====HEADER; cat $D/blocks/Header.md; echo ====EXTFEAT; cat $D/blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md; echo ====BANNER; cat $D/blocks/Banner.md

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor; echo ====README-PROPS; sed -n 118,175p $P/README.md; echo ====VITE; rg -n -i -C 8 'vite' $P/README.md | head -60; echo ====ANIMATED; rg -n -C 3 'animated' $P/README.md | head -40; echo ====BTN-TYPES; rg -n -A 14 'export interface ButtonProps' $P/build/esm/models/constructor-items/common.d.ts | head -40; rg -n -B2 -A 10 'export interface TitleProps|export interface TitleItemBaseProps|export type ThemedColor|export type ButtonTheme|export type ButtonSize' $P/build/esm/models/constructor-items/common.d.ts | head -80; echo ====BANNER-COLOR; rg -n -C 4 'color' $P/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.js | head -40; echo ====SASS; ls node_modules/sass/package.json 2>/dev/null && grep '"version"' node_modules/sass/package.json; ls node_modules/vite-plugin-dynamic-import 2>/dev/null | head -2

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm; echo ====ANIM; rg -n 'animated' $P/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.js $P/components/BlockBase/BlockBase.js $P/components/AnimateBlock/AnimateBlock.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ====BTN; rg -n -C 3 "theme" $P/components/Button/Button.js | head -50; echo ====BANNERCSS; rg -n -A 3 'theme_(light|dark)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.css | head -30; echo ====UIKIT-HOOK; rg -n 'useThemeType|useThemeValue' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts

npm install -D sass vite-plugin-dynamic-import 2>&1 | grep -v 'allow-scripts\|audit\|^$' | tail -5; grep '"version"' node_modules/sass/package.json node_modules/vite-plugin-dynamic-import/package.json
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm; rg -n -B1 -A4 'export declare enum Theme\b|export (declare )?(type|enum) Theme ' $P/models/common.d.ts $P/models/*.d.ts | head -20; rg -n 'Theme' $P/index.d.ts | head -5

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm; rg -n "Theme" $P/index.d.ts $P/models/index.d.ts | head; sed -i "s|import { PageConstructor, PageConstructorProvider } from '@gravity-ui/page-constructor';|import { PageConstructor, PageConstructorProvider, Theme } from '@gravity-ui/page-constructor';|; s|<PageConstructorProvider theme={theme}>|<PageConstructorProvider theme={theme === 'dark' ? Theme.Dark : Theme.Light}>|" src/App.tsx && cat src/App.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
rg -n "~" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/*.scss | head -20

npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v '^\s*at ' | sed -n 1,20p; echo ====USES; rg -n "from 'url'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm --glob '*.js' | head; echo ====PKG-URL; ls node_modules/url/package.json 2>/dev/null && grep '"version"' node_modules/url/package.json
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v '^\s*at ' | grep -i -B2 -A6 'error\|url' | sed -n 1,40p

npm install url 2>&1 | grep -i 'added\|error' | head -3; grep '"version"' node_modules/url/package.json; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v '^\s*at \|DEPRECATION\|sass-lang\|^\s*[╷│╵]\|^$\|root stylesheet\|repetitive' | tail -15
rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff package.json
